questions.stemHtml: A 2-month-old infant is brought to the pediatrician by his mother, who is concerned about his poor feeding and blue-tinged skin, particularly during crying. Upon physical examination, the pediatrician notes a harsh pan systolic murmur at the upper sternal border. The infant's growth parameters are below the third percentile for his age. A chest X-ray is ordered, which is as shown below All of the following are true about this condition except?

options.label: A
options.text: Left sided aortic arch is seen

options.label: C
options.text: Sub pulmonic stenosis determines the severity

options.label: D
options.text: Multiple ventricular septal defects may be seen
